name: Historical event list on the 15 km Japan map: early firing by research with the advisor popup for the human only, a rename, no re-fire after load, boosts in the year for factions without the research

steps.code: local function pid(c) for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()==c then return p:GetID() end end error(c..' absent') end; local function el() return Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1 end; local function f(id,e) return Players[id]:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_FIRED_JAC_EVENT_'..e) end; if el()~=1 then error('not elapsed turn 1: '..el()) end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT')~=nil then error('events fired before forcing') end; local nagao,shimazu=pid('CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO'),pid('CIVILIZATION_JAC_SHIMAZU'); Players[0]:GetTechs():SetTech(GameInfo.Technologies['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_GRAIN_STORES'].Index,true); Players[nagao]:GetCulture():SetCivic(GameInfo.Civics['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_COURT_AND_SHOGUNATE_ENVOYS'].Index,true); Players[shimazu]:GetCulture():SetCivic(GameInfo.Civics['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_KOKUJIN_LEAGUES'].Index,true); return 'forced: Oda grain stores (famine, advisor), Nagao court envoys (Uesugi), Shimazu kokujin leagues (AI advisor)'

local function pid(c) for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()==c then return p:GetID() end end error(c..' absent') end; local function el() return Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1 end; local function f(id,e) return Players[id]:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_FIRED_JAC_EVENT_'..e) end; local n=0; for row in GameInfo.JAC_HistoricalEvents() do for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if p:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_FIRED_'..row.EventType)~=nil then n=n+1 end end end; if n~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT') then error('fire count '..tostring(Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT'))..' ~= flags '..n) end; local oda,nagao,shimazu=pid('CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA'),pid('CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO'),pid('CIVILIZATION_JAC_SHIMAZU'); if oda~=0 then error('Oda is not player 0') end; if f(oda,'TENBUN_FAMINE')~=2 then error('famine not fired early for Oda on turn 2: '..tostring(f(oda,'TENBUN_FAMINE'))) end; if f(nagao,'NAGAO_TO_UESUGI')~=2 then error('Nagao rename not fired on turn 2') end; if f(shimazu,'SHIMAZU_UNIFY_1')~=2 then error('Shimazu event not fired on turn 2') end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_CIV_NAME_CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO')~='LOC_JAC_EVENT_UESUGI_CIV_NAME' then error('rename property missing') end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_CIV_NAME_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA')~=nil then error('Oda renamed early') end; return 'elapsed='..el()..' fires='..Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT')

local keys={}; for k in pairs(JAC_EVENTS_ADVISOR_SHOWN) do table.insert(keys,k) end; table.sort(keys); for _,k in ipairs(keys) do if k:find('SHIMAZU',1,true) or k:find('KANTO',1,true) then error('AI advisor shown to the human: '..k) end end; return table.concat(keys,',')

condition.code: local t=Controls.InfoString:GetText() or ''; return IsBlockingInput() and (t:find(Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_EVENT_TENBUN_FAMINE_ADVISOR'),1,true)~=nil or t:find(Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_EVENT_TENSHO_QUAKE_ADVISOR'),1,true)~=nil)

steps.code: local t=Controls.InfoString:GetText(); if IsBlockingInput() then OnHideAdvisorDialog() end; return t

local y=Calendar.MakeYearStr(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()); if not string.find(y,'1540',1,true) then error('engine date is not 1540: '..tostring(y)) end; return y

local function pid(c) for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()==c then return p:GetID() end end error(c..' absent') end; local function el() return Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1 end; local function f(id,e) return Players[id]:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_FIRED_JAC_EVENT_'..e) end; if el()~=19 then error('not elapsed turn 19: '..el()) end; local t=GameInfo.Technologies['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_GRAIN_STORES'].Index; local boosted=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id=p:GetID(); local b=p:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_TENBUN_FAMINE'); if f(id,'TENBUN_FAMINE')==nil then if b~=19 then error('player '..id..' neither fired nor boosted on turn 19: '..tostring(b)) end; if not p:GetTechs():HasBoostBeenTriggered(t) then error('player '..id..' has no grain-stores boost') end; boosted=boosted+1 end end; if boosted==0 then error('every faction researched grain stores; the boost-only path was not exercised') end; if f(0,'TENBUN_FAMINE')~=2 or Players[0]:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_TENBUN_FAMINE')~=nil then error('Oda famine flags changed') end; local date=pid('CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE'); local c=GameInfo.Civics['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_DOMAIN_LAW'].Index; local jin; if f(date,'JINKAISHU')~=nil and Players[date]:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_JINKAISHU')==nil then jin='Date researched domain law first (fired '..f(date,'JINKAISHU')..')' else if Players[date]:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_JINKAISHU')~=8 then error('Date not boosted on turn 8: '..tostring(Players[date]:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_JINKAISHU'))) end; if not Players[date]:GetCulture():HasBoostBeenTriggered(c) then error('Date has no domain-law inspiration') end; jin='Date inspired on turn 8' end; return 'turn 19 (1540): '..boosted..' factions boosted toward grain stores; '..jin
